summary: Lennar Corp and numerous subsidiary co-registrants, including Greystone Nevada LLC, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-10-15 under an existing shelf registration (File 333-294985), covering debt securities guaranteed by the parent and affiliated homebuilding entities. The excerpt discloses only registrant identification and filing metadata; no pricing, principal amount, coupon, maturity, or underwriting terms appear. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation, so no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural deal mechanics are stated. Watch for the final pricing term sheet to confirm size, tenor, and guarantees.
